content: Takes the subset from prepare, finds by brute force the distance from each test image to the training images, and decides the digit by a majority vote of the k nearest (scikit-learn, 1 thread). Training only memorises, so the time shows in prediction. Shows the accuracy, the time, a breakdown of the mistakes and the digits it got wrong with their neighbours, and passes predictions for every test image to compare.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Accuracy, CPU time, settings, and predictions for every test image
